author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
I’m so proud to announce my family and I are launching  @CavemanTools  a tool company built for homeowners.

I spent 25+ years as a contractor and the last 10 years teaching homeowners how to renovate on YouTube. In 10 years of Home RenoVision DIY we've reached over 1 billion views and have helped tens of millions of homeowners tackle their home projects themselves by helping them save money, hours of frustration and build confidence along the way. We’ve learned a lot about which tools and products homeowners need to be successful on their projects. 

We’re building Caveman Tools for all of you. We’re setting out to solve real homeowner problems and create tools that make it easier for you to achieve professional results.

Most homeowners have 3 or 4 kits in their garage collecting dust. Bits are missing and half of the bits have never been touched.

And a lot of people can’t tell you what half the bits in their kit are used for. 

Introducing the Ultimate Homeowner's Drill Bit Kit.
title: Two Years in the Making.. Launching Soon!
